# Bay Greenery

> Licensed landscape contractor (CA License C-27 #1146610) based in Cupertino, California, serving residential and commercial clients across the South Bay and Peninsula. Owner-operated by Nathan, with a focus on thoughtful planning, careful construction, and dependable ongoing care.

Bay Greenery handles the full lifecycle of outdoor spaces: landscape design and build, construction (retaining walls, irrigation installation, lighting, sod, artificial turf, decomposed granite, grading, fencing), irrigation repair, landscape repair, maintenance, cleanups, and consultations.

## Services

- [Landscape Construction](https://www.baygreenery.com/services/landscape-construction/): retaining walls, irrigation installs, lighting, sod, artificial turf, grading, decomposed granite, fencing.
- [Landscape Design & Build](https://www.baygreenery.com/services/landscape-design-build/): full landscape remodels from concept through installation.
- [Irrigation Repair](https://www.baygreenery.com/services/irrigation-repair/): sprinkler and drip repair, leaks, valves, controllers, root damage.
- [Landscape Repair](https://www.baygreenery.com/services/landscape-repair/): fences, walls, paths, lighting, and drainage fixes.
- [Landscape Maintenance](https://www.baygreenery.com/services/landscape-maintenance/): customized maintenance programs.
- [Landscape Cleanup & Restoration](https://www.baygreenery.com/services/cleanup-restoration/): seasonal and one-time cleanups, clean-slate clearouts.
- [Consultations](https://www.baygreenery.com/services/consultations/): planning, second opinions, site evaluations.

## Service areas with completed projects

- [San Jose](https://www.baygreenery.com/areas/san-jose/), including [Almaden Valley](https://www.baygreenery.com/areas/almaden-valley/)
- [Ladera](https://www.baygreenery.com/areas/ladera/) (Portola Valley / Menlo Park)
- [Portola Valley](https://www.baygreenery.com/areas/portola-valley/)
- [Campbell](https://www.baygreenery.com/areas/campbell/)

The wider South Bay and Peninsula are also served.
